annual_report.business: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited is an engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company focused on infrastructure and construction projects including roads, highways, bridges, rail corridors, airports, ports, power infrastructure and urban redevelopment.

auditor.name: Borkar & Muzumdar, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on standalone and consolidated financial results for year ended 31 March 2026. Qualifications relate to: (1) Interest reversal of ₹2,78,805.87 lakhs for three lenders pending No Dues Certificates, with non-accrual of interest of ₹10,907.54 lakhs for quarter and ₹21,436.79 lakhs for year, resulting in overstatement of profit and net worth by ₹3,00,242.66 lakhs. (2) Long-outstanding trade receivables of ₹75,644.24 lakhs, unbilled revenue of ₹650.24 lakhs and other receivables of ₹611.02 lakhs with no Expected Credit Loss adjustment per Ind AS 109. (3) Investment in Supreme Panvel Indapur Tollways Private Limited (SPITPL) of ₹15,677.22 lakhs, trade receivables of ₹3,814.98 lakhs and unbilled revenue of ₹3,201.67 lakhs, with SPITPL admitted to CIRP on 30 August 2024. Emphasis of matter on corporate guarantees of ₹1,51,347.85 lakhs to lenders of subsidiary/group companies and one-time settlement gain of ₹3,67,801.46 lakhs. Going concern material uncertainty noted with net loss of ₹6,026.14 lakhs for quarter, accumulated losses of ₹99,402.93 lakhs and net worth of ₹23,723.24 lakhs as at 31 March 2026.

key_risks: Recoverability of long-outstanding receivables and investments
Impairment assessment of investments in subsidiaries/associates under CIRP
Interest reversal and pending No Dues Certificates from lenders
Corporate guarantees to lenders of subsidiary/group companies
Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses and pending settlements
